truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: This criterion was employed to exclude the blue region in Fig.~\ref{fig:CoolingBound}~\cite{Lella:2023bfb}, corresponding to axion-proton couplings $5\times10^{-10}\lesssim g_{ap}\lesssim3\times10^{-6}$ for $m_a\lesssim30\,$MeV and $g_{an}=0$.

original_text: For axion masses $m_a\lesssim 10^{-9}$~eV, the dominant contribution to the conversion probability is given by the magnetic field hosted by the Milky Way.
injected_text: For axion masses $m_a\lesssim 10^{-8}$~eV, the dominant contribution to the conversion probability is given by the magnetic field hosted by the Milky Way.
rationale: Constraint tension: this paper's abstract is fully qualitative (zero numerical values), and no decimal-precision number is repeated in two distinct sections, so a literal abstract-vs-body second-decimal drift is not realisable. The best available anchor is the Galactic-magnetic-field-dominated mass threshold m_a <= 10^{-9} eV, which is stated twice in the 'Light axions' subsection: once when introducing the regime, and once when reporting the resulting SMM bound from Fiorillo:2025gnd. I perturb only the first occurrence to 10^{-8} eV; the second occurrence (still 10^{-9} eV) provides the visible inconsistency a numerics auditor must reconcile. This is the kind of slip an author could plausibly make when redrafting the paragraph and forgetting to propagate the threshold.
ground_truth_description: In the 'Light axions' subsection, the introductory sentence's stated mass threshold for Galactic-magnetic-field-dominated axion-photon conversion was changed from m_a <= 10^{-9} eV to m_a <= 10^{-8} eV, while the same subsection's later sentence (citing Fiorillo:2025gnd) still quotes the original 10^{-9} eV threshold for the same physical regime, producing a within-paper numerical inconsistency.

ground_truth_description: Changed one in-line occurrence of the axion-photon coupling symbol from g_{a\gamma} to g_{\gamma a} in the SMM Galactic-conversion bound for SN 1987A, while every other occurrence in the paper still uses g_{a\gamma}.

truth.affected_span_verbatim: In the scenario in which axions were produced in the core of SN 1987A via nuclear couplings and then converted within the Galactic magnetic field, the non-observation of any signal by the SMM rules out values of the product of the coupling $g_{ap}\times g_{a\gamma}\gtrsim4\times10^{-24}\,{\rm GeV}^{-1}$ for $m_a\lesssim10^{-9}\,{\rm eV}$~\cite{Fiorillo:2025gnd} with small variations depending on the choice of the magnetic field model.
